spans.s:
Neṣṭṛ, the name of one of the chief priests at the Soma
sacrifice, occurs in the Rigveda^1 and later.^2 See Ṛtvij.
1) i. 15, 3; ii. 5, 5, etc.
2) Taittirīya Saṃhitā, i. 8, 18, 1;
vi. 5, 8, 5. 6; Aitareya Brāhmaṇa,
vi. 3, 10, etc.; Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa,
iii. 8, 2, 1, etc.; Pañcaviṃśa Brāh-
maṇa, xxv. 15, etc.
Cf. Hillebrandt, Vedische Mythologie,
1, 250, 261, 527.
